text:
maria: Hey team — proposing a dry-run for a joint SEV handoff process with OrionTech (hardware partner) and the Marketplace team. Goal: validate shared Slack channel + war room flow, roles, and the automated PagerDuty -> channel handoff. Thinking Tuesday 09:30 PT. Thoughts?

lena: +1. Do we want the shared channel to be private or public to both orgs? I'd vote private with guest invite for partner reps.

sam: Partner prefers private. Can do a guest Slack account for our 2 reps (will need invite by Monday). Also want an on-call ping to go to their secondary oncall.

dan: For the dry-run we should test three failure classes: cold-start capacity, image-provision fail, and auth token rotation. Each should trigger the same handoff.

alex: I can draft a checklist. High level runbook steps: 1) create ephemeral channel #sev-oriontech-demo 2) bridge + screen-share 3) assign bridge runner 4) handback and postmortem cadence.

maria: Nice. I'll own channel creation and partner invites. lena can own Marketplace liaison. dan you and SRE should own the remediation playbook items. alex do PR for the runbook doc. sam will bring partner oncall details.

lena: Volunteers: Bridge runner = @lena, Liaison (Marketplace PM) = @maria, SRE oncall = @dan, Support lead = @alex, Partner rep = @sam. Sound good?

sam: That works. For partner escalation path: PagerDuty -> primary oncall (OrionTech), if no ack in 5m -> Redwood escalates to Redwood bridge runner. We'll simulate a failed ack for the dry-run.

incident-bot: Reminder: create channel before scheduled time or the bot won't auto-provision war-room resources.

dan: Quick config snippet for pager rule we'll simulate: ```
# dry-run pd rule
service: marketplace-prod
escalation_policy: test-orionhand
timeout: 300
actions:
  - notify: orion_primary_oncall
  - after: 300
    notify: redwood_bridge_runner
```

alex: Added checklist draft here: https://docs.internal/redwood/sev-handovers/orion-dryrun (please comment). Key test cases: partner ack, partner slow ack, partner unreachable -> Redwood takes lead.

maria: Logistics: Tuesday 09:30 PT, channel created at 09:15 PT, partners invited 09:20 PT, SRE sim fires 09:30 PT. I'll post the final invite.

lena: Can we also test the console dashboards access? Partner needs read-only to per-route latency. sam can confirm.

sam: Confirmed — partner read-only view ok. Note: need IP allowlist entry for their VPN IPs — I'll send to infra.

dan: One more: during the war room, please use the `ops/handback` thread template in the runbook. Example message: `ops: Handback to partner - root cause provision image mismatch; mitigation applied; next steps: partner to patch firmware v2.3 by EOD`

alex: I'll add a quick A/B step to the runbook to test canary fallback to a smaller model (simulated) so routing fallbacks are exercised.

maria: Love it. If no objections I'll lock time and post invites by EOD. :thumbsup:

lena: :thumbsup:

sam: :+1: will prepare partner PD entries and test creds before Monday.

dan: :white_check_mark: SRE will create simulated incidents and monitor handoff time.

alex: I'll open the PR for the runbook and tag everyone for reviews.

maria: Final note — we'll record the session and collect a 15m postmortem checklist. Target outcome: <5m handoff and clear handback notes.

lena: See you Tuesday.
